title: Over a hundred crash retrieval cases in Majic Eyes Only
summary: UAPGerb tells of Over a hundred crash retrieval cases in Majic Eyes Only, about 20th century at various, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: look at Ryan S. Wood's fantastic book, Magic Eyes Only, we can find over a hundred cases of of UFO crash retrieval.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels to look at Majic Eyes Only, a book by researcher Ryan S. Wood. UAPGerb says the book lists more than a hundred cases where crashed UFOs were said to have been recovered. If true, it would mean such recoveries happened again and again, not just once.
